PT Sans Regular — ParaType Ltd.
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts (ofl/ptsans/PT_Sans-Web-Regular.ttf), `main` branch,
fetched 13 Oct 2026. (The sandbox has no network access to fonts.google.com or
dejavu-fonts.org directly; google/fonts' OFL mirror on GitHub is the one usable
source on the allowlist — github.com / raw.githubusercontent.com.)

License: SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (full text: OFL.txt, copied verbatim
from the same repo). Reserved Font Names: "PT Sans", "ParaType". OFL explicitly
permits embedding fonts in software/binaries; the only restriction is you cannot
sell the font file by itself under the reserved name. Read before committing,
per the Session 11 instruction — confirmed, not assumed.

Why PT Sans and not DejaVu: DejaVu's GitHub repo (dejavu-fonts/dejavu-fonts) ships
only build sources (SFD + scripts), no prebuilt .ttf, in the commit this sandbox
could fetch. PT Sans is a real static (non-variable) TTF with a permissive OFL
license, confirmed working with stb_truetype (valid 0x00010000 sfnt header,
442960 bytes). Swap fonts later if the author wants something else — just update
this file and modules/paint's embedded-font CMake step.

Used by: modules/paint (DrawText rasterization via stb_truetype), embedded into
the binary the same way modules/js embeds its JS prelude (see
modules/paint/embed_font.cmake, modeled on js/embed_prelude.cmake).
